<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InternshipOffer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyRecommendation" name="Company recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Applicant" name="Start internship application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" name="Continue after optional details"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive internship offer" messageRef="Message_InternshipOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny offer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week1" name="Wait one week for first status update">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_Week1">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate1" name="Write internship status update 1"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week2" name="Wait one week for second status update">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_Week2">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate2" name="Write internship status update 2"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week3" name="Wait one week for third status update">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_Week3">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StatusUpdate3" name="Write internship status update 3"/>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForWeekOrFinish" name="Wait for next week or internship finish"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NextWeek" name="Next weekly status update due">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_NextWeek">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_InternshipFinished">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internshipFinished}</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WeeklyStatusUpdate" name="Write weekly internship status update"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRecommendationTweet" name="Send company recommendation tweet to a friend via Twitter" messageRef="Message_CompanyRecommendation">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${numberOfFriends}</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Applicant" name="Recommendation tweets sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Applicant" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enterExperienceAndHobbies}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Event_Week1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Event_Week1" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate1" targetRef="Event_Week2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Event_Week2" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate2" targetRef="Event_Week3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" sourceRef="Event_Week3" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate3" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForWeekOrFinish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A19" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForWeekOrFinish" targetRef="Event_NextWeek"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A20" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForWeekOrFinish" targetRef="Event_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A21" sourceRef="Event_NextWeek" targetRef="Task_WeeklyStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A22" sourceRef="Task_WeeklyStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForWeekOrFinish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A23" sourceRef="Event_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A24" sourceRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweet" targetRef="End_Applicant"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company status updates about the intern" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Company" name="Start company status updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate1" name="Write status update 1 about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate2" name="Write status update 2 about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate3" name="Write status update 3 about the intern"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Company" name="Three company status updates written"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Company" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate1" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate2" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdate3" targetRef="End_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="You" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OfferProviders" name="Offer providers"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Internship offers" sourceRef="Participant_OfferProviders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_InternshipOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RecommendationTweets" name="Recommendation tweets" sourceRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweet" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_CompanyRecommendation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
